'''Adam Nelson''' (DeckTech handle '''Skipray''')<ref name="dt-23994">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23994 Droid Deal v 1 0], DeckTech (Adam "Skipray" Nelson, 17 June 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23994/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23994/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009085050/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23994/ Wayback Machine].</ref> is a Star Wars Customizable Card Game player. He posted a [[Dark]] [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time]] list on DeckTech (''Droid Deal v 1 0'').
